cohort: 115 pregnant patients at the Department of Radio-diagnosis in collaboration with Department of Obstetrics & Gynecology, Burdwan Medical College and Hospital
finding: Myocardial performance index (MPI) is a better predictor of adverse perinatal outcome than abnormal IVCT or IVRT and has a high sensitivity (88.8%) in predicting adverse fetal outcomes and 92.3% in predicting perinatal mortality.
mod_finding: 57.4% of participants had a normal vaginal delivery, 17.4% had a vaginal delivery with induction, and 25.2% underwent caesarean section.
birth_weight: 82.6% of babies had normal birth weight and 17.4% were low birth weight.
